title: Observable Lyapunov Exponents for Globally Coupled Maps in the Mean-Field Limit
summary: Large coupled systems may be chaotic at the microscopic level while exhibiting stable collective behaviour at the macroscopic level. Distinguishing between these two forms of instability has been a problem in the physics literature, and several approaches have been proposed. In this paper, we address this problem by introducing and studying \emph{observable Lyapunov exponents}, which measure the rate at which perturbations of initial conditions grow or decay when viewed through a chosen observable, rather than in the full phase space.
